Audit server against CIS Level 1 benchmarks

{
  "fields": {
    "name": "cis-level1-audit",
    "description": "Run CIS Benchmark Level 1 checks",
    "stop_on_error": false,
    "steps": [
      {
        "id": "1",
        "undo": false,
        "name": "check-password-policy",
        "action_type": "SHELL",
        "code": "grep -q \"^PASS_MAX_DAYS.*90\" /etc/login.defs && grep -q \"^PASS_MIN_DAYS.*7\" /etc/login.defs && echo \"PASS: password aging\" || echo \"FAIL: password aging\"",
        "target": "all",
        "parent_step_ids": []
      },
      {
        "id": "2",
        "undo": false,
        "name": "check-permissions",
        "action_type": "SHELL",
        "code": "STAT=$(stat -c \"%a\" /etc/passwd); test \"$STAT\" = \"644\" && echo \"PASS: /etc/passwd perms\" || echo \"FAIL: /etc/passwd perms=$STAT\"",
        "target": "all",
        "parent_step_ids": []
      },
      {
        "id": "3",
        "undo": false,
        "name": "check-no-empty-pass",
        "action_type": "SHELL",
        "code": "EMPTY=$(awk -F: \"($2 == \"\")\" /etc/shadow | wc -l); test \"$EMPTY\" -eq 0 && echo \"PASS: no empty passwords\" || echo \"FAIL: $EMPTY empty passwords\"",
        "target": "all",
        "parent_step_ids": []
      },
      {
        "id": "4",
        "undo": false,
        "name": "check-root-path",
        "action_type": "SHELL",
        "code": "echo \"$PATH\" | grep -q \"\\.::\" && echo \"FAIL: dot in root PATH\" || echo \"PASS: root PATH clean\"",
        "target": "all",
        "parent_step_ids": []
      },
      {
        "id": "5",
        "undo": false,
        "name": "check-sshd-config",
        "action_type": "SHELL",
        "code": "grep -q \"^PermitRootLogin no\" /etc/ssh/sshd_config && echo \"PASS: root login disabled\" || echo \"FAIL: root login may be enabled\"",
        "target": "all",
        "parent_step_ids": []
      },
      {
        "id": "6",
        "undo": false,
        "name": "generate-report",
        "action_type": "SHELL",
        "code": "echo \"=== CIS Level 1 Audit Complete ===\" && echo \"Check syslog for details\"",
        "target": "all",
        "parent_step_ids": [
          "1",
          "2",
          "3",
          "4",
          "5"
        ]
      }
    ]
  },
  "explanation": "CIS Level 1: parallel checks for password policy, file perms, empty passwords, PATH, SSH config, then report."
}

Run a security audit of user accounts and permissions

{
  "fields": {
    "name": "user-security-audit",
    "description": "Audit system users and permissions",
    "stop_on_error": false,
    "steps": [
      {
        "id": "1",
        "undo": false,
        "name": "find-uid0-users",
        "action_type": "SHELL",
        "code": "awk -F: \"\\$3==0{print \\$1}\" /etc/passwd | tee /tmp/audit_uid0.txt",
        "target": "all",
        "parent_step_ids": []
      },
      {
        "id": "2",
        "undo": false,
        "name": "find-empty-passwords",
        "action_type": "SHELL",
        "code": "awk -F: \"(\\$2==\"\"||\\$2==\"!\")\" /etc/shadow 2>/dev/null | tee /tmp/audit_empty_pass.txt; true",
        "target": "all",
        "parent_step_ids": []
      },
      {
        "id": "3",
        "undo": false,
        "name": "list-sudo-users",
        "action_type": "SHELL",
        "code": "getent group sudo | cut -d: -f4 | tee /tmp/audit_sudo.txt",
        "target": "all",
        "parent_step_ids": []
      },
      {
        "id": "4",
        "undo": false,
        "name": "check-login-shells",
        "action_type": "SHELL",
        "code": "awk -F: \"\\$7 !~ /(nologin|false)/{print \\$1,\\$7}\" /etc/passwd | tee /tmp/audit_shells.txt",
        "target": "all",
        "parent_step_ids": []
      },
      {
        "id": "5",
        "undo": false,
        "name": "find-old-logins",
        "action_type": "SHELL",
        "code": "lastlog -b 90 | grep -v \"Never\" | tee /tmp/audit_old_logins.txt; true",
        "target": "all",
        "parent_step_ids": []
      },
      {
        "id": "6",
        "undo": false,
        "name": "generate-audit-report",
        "action_type": "SHELL",
        "code": "echo \"=== User Audit Report ===\" && echo \"UID 0 users: $(wc -l < /tmp/audit_uid0.txt)\" && echo \"Empty passwords: $(wc -l < /tmp/audit_empty_pass.txt)\" && echo \"Sudo users: $(cat /tmp/audit_sudo.txt)\" && echo \"Login shells: $(wc -l < /tmp/audit_shells.txt)\" && echo \"Inactive 90d: $(wc -l < /tmp/audit_old_logins.txt)\"",
        "target": "all",
        "parent_step_ids": [
          "1",
          "2",
          "3",
          "4",
          "5"
        ]
      }
    ]
  },
  "explanation": "User audit: parallel check UID0, empty passwords, sudo, login shells, inactive accounts, then report."
}

Deploy custom Prometheus textfile collector

{
  "fields": {
    "name": "custom-metrics-exporter",
    "description": "Deploy custom metrics endpoint via script",
    "stop_on_error": true,
    "undo_on_error": true,
    "steps": [
      {
        "id": "1",
        "undo": false,
        "name": "create-metrics-script",
        "action_type": "SHELL",
        "code": "cat > /usr/local/bin/custom-metrics.sh <<SCRIPT\n#!/bin/bash\nwhile true; do\n  LOAD=$(cat /proc/loadavg | awk \"{print \\$1}\")\n  DISK=$(df / | awk \"NR==2{print \\$5}\" | tr -d \"%\")\n  MEM=$(free | awk \"/Mem:/{printf(\"%d\",\\$3/\\$2*100)}\")\n  cat <<METRICS > /var/lib/prometheus/node-exporter/custom.prom\nnode_custom_load_1m $LOAD\nnode_custom_disk_pct $DISK\nnode_custom_mem_pct $MEM\nMETRICS\n  sleep 15\ndone\nSCRIPT\nchmod +x /usr/local/bin/custom-metrics.sh",
        "target": "all",
        "parent_step_ids": []
      },
      {
        "id": "2",
        "undo": false,
        "name": "create-textfile-dir",
        "action_type": "SHELL",
        "code": "mkdir -p /var/lib/prometheus/node-exporter",
        "target": "all",
        "parent_step_ids": []
      },
      {
        "id": "3",
        "undo": false,
        "name": "create-systemd-unit",
        "action_type": "SHELL",
        "code": "cat > /etc/systemd/system/custom-metrics.service <<SVC\n[Unit]\nDescription=Custom Metrics Collector\nAfter=network.target\n[Service]\nExecStart=/usr/local/bin/custom-metrics.sh\nRestart=always\n[Install]\nWantedBy=multi-user.target\nSVC\nsystemctl daemon-reload",
        "target": "all",
        "parent_step_ids": [
          "1",
          "2"
        ]
      },
      {
        "id": "4",
        "undo": false,
        "name": "start-metrics",
        "action_type": "SHELL",
        "code": "systemctl enable --now custom-metrics",
        "target": "all",
        "parent_step_ids": [
          "3"
        ]
      },
      {
        "id": "5",
        "undo": false,
        "name": "verify-metrics",
        "action_type": "SHELL",
        "code": "sleep 20 && cat /var/lib/prometheus/node-exporter/custom.prom | grep node_custom",
        "target": "all",
        "parent_step_ids": [
          "4"
        ],
        "expected_rc": 0
      },
      {
        "id": "6",
        "undo": true,
        "name": "undo-custom-metrics",
        "action_type": "SHELL",
        "code": "systemctl stop custom-metrics; systemctl disable custom-metrics; rm /etc/systemd/system/custom-metrics.service /usr/local/bin/custom-metrics.sh; systemctl daemon-reload",
        "parent_step_ids": [
          "3"
        ]
      }
    ]
  },
  "explanation": "Custom metrics: create collector script, textfile dir, systemd unit, start, verify prom file."
}

Configure auditd for security audit trail

{
  "fields": {
    "name": "audit-logging",
    "description": "Configure auditd audit logging",
    "stop_on_error": true,
    "undo_on_error": true,
    "steps": [
      {
        "id": "1",
        "undo": false,
        "name": "install-auditd",
        "action_type": "SHELL",
        "code": "apt-get update && apt-get install -y auditd audispd-plugins",
        "target": "all",
        "parent_step_ids": []
      },
      {
        "id": "2",
        "undo": false,
        "name": "add-file-watch-rules",
        "action_type": "SHELL",
        "code": "cat > /etc/audit/rules.d/custom.rules <<RULES\n-w /etc/passwd -p wa -k identity\n-w /etc/shadow -p wa -k identity\n-w /etc/sudoers -p wa -k sudo_changes\n-w /etc/ssh/sshd_config -p wa -k sshd_config\nRULES",
        "target": "all",
        "parent_step_ids": [
          "1"
        ]
      },
      {
        "id": "3",
        "undo": false,
        "name": "add-exec-rules",
        "action_type": "SHELL",
        "code": "cat >> /etc/audit/rules.d/custom.rules <<RULES\n-a always,exit -F arch=b64 -S execve -k exec_log\n-a always,exit -F arch=b64 -S connect -k network\nRULES",
        "target": "all",
        "parent_step_ids": [
          "2"
        ]
      },
      {
        "id": "4",
        "undo": false,
        "name": "restart-auditd",
        "action_type": "SHELL",
        "code": "systemctl restart auditd",
        "target": "all",
        "parent_step_ids": [
          "3"
        ]
      },
      {
        "id": "5",
        "undo": false,
        "name": "verify-audit-rules",
        "action_type": "SHELL",
        "code": "auditctl -l | grep -c identity",
        "target": "all",
        "parent_step_ids": [
          "4"
        ],
        "expected_rc": 0
      },
      {
        "id": "6",
        "undo": true,
        "name": "undo-auditd",
        "action_type": "SHELL",
        "code": "rm /etc/audit/rules.d/custom.rules; systemctl restart auditd",
        "parent_step_ids": [
          "2"
        ]
      }
    ]
  },
  "explanation": "Audit logging: install auditd, add file watch + exec rules, restart, verify loaded rules."
}

{
  "fields": {
    "name": "audit-logging",
    "description": "Configure auditd audit logging",
    "stop_on_error": true,
    "undo_on_error": true,
    "steps": [
      {
        "id": "1",
        "undo": false,
        "name": "install-auditd",
        "action_type": "SHELL",
        "code": "apt-get update && apt-get install -y auditd audispd-plugins",

        "undo": false,

        "target": "all",
        "parent_step_ids": [
          "1"
        ]
      },
      {
        "id": "3",
        "undo": false,
        "name": "add-exec-rules",
        "action_type": "SHELL",
        "code": "cat >> /etc/audit/rules.d/custom.rules <<RULES\n-a always,exit -F arch=b64 -S execve -k exec_log\n-a always,exit -F arch=b64 -S connect -k network\nRULES",
        "target": "all",
        "parent_step_ids": [
          "2"
        ]
      },
      {
        "id": "4",
        "undo": false,
        "name": "restart-auditd",
        "action_type": "SHELL",
        "code": "systemctl restart auditd",
        "target": "all",
        "parent_step_ids": [
          "3"
        ]
      },
      {
        "id": "5",
        "undo": false,
        "name": "verify-audit-rules",

        "target": "all",
        "parent_step_ids": [

        "id": "6",
        "undo": true,

        "parent_step_ids": [
          "2"
        ]
      }

  "explanation": "Audit logging: install auditd, add file watch + exec rules, restart, verify loaded rules."

    "name": "user-security-audit",
    "description": "Audit system users and permissions",
    "stop_on_error": false,

      {
        "id": "1",
        "undo": false,
        "name": "find-uid0-users",
        "action_type": "SHELL",

        "target": "all",

      {
        "id": "2",
        "undo": false,
        "name": "find-empty-passwords",
        "action_type": "SHELL",

        "target": "all",
        "parent_step_ids": []
      },
      {
        "id": "3",
        "undo": false,
        "name": "list-sudo-users",
        "action_type": "SHELL",
        "code": "getent group sudo | cut -d: -f4 | tee /tmp/audit_sudo.txt",
        "target": "all",

      },

        "id": "4",

        "name": "check-login-shells",

      {
        "id": "5",
        "undo": false,
        "name": "find-old-logins",
        "action_type": "SHELL",
        "code": "lastlog -b 90 | grep -v \"Never\" | tee /tmp/audit_old_logins.txt; true",
        "target": "all",
        "parent_step_ids": []
      },
      {
        "id": "6",
        "undo": false,
        "name": "generate-audit-report",
        "action_type": "SHELL",
        "code": "echo \"=== User Audit Report ===\" && echo \"UID 0 users: $(wc -l < /tmp/audit_uid0.txt)\" && echo \"Empty passwords: $(wc -l < /tmp/audit_empty_pass.txt)\" && echo \"Sudo users: $(cat /tmp/audit_sudo.txt)\" && echo \"Login shells: $(wc -l < /tmp/audit_shells.txt)\" && echo \"Inactive 90d: $(wc -l < /tmp/audit_old_logins.txt)\"",
        "target": "all",
        "parent_step_ids": [
          "1",
          "2",
          "3",
          "4",
          "5"

        "undo": false,
        "name": "find-uid0-users",

        "undo": false,

Ansible playbook that sets up Docker Swarm mode for lab cluster

{
  "fields": {
    "name": "Initialize Docker Swarm",
    "action_type": "ANSIBLE",
    "code": "- name: Check if swarm is already initialized
  command: docker info --format "{{.Swarm.LocalNodeState}}"
  register: swarm_state
  changed_when: false
  failed_when: false

- name: Initialize Docker Swarm
  docker_swarm:
    state: present
    advertise_addr: "{{input.advertise_addr}}"
  register: swarm_init
  when: swarm_state.stdout != "active"

- name: Get swarm join tokens
  command: docker swarm join-token {{ item }} -q
  loop:
    - worker
    - manager
  register: join_tokens
  changed_when: false

- name: Display swarm info
  debug:
    msg: "Swarm initialized. Worker token: {{ join_tokens.results[0].stdout }}, Manager token: {{ join_tokens.results[1].stdout }}"
",
    "schema": {
      "input": {
        "advertise_addr": {
          "type": "string",
          "description": "IP address or interface to advertise to other nodes"
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "advertise_addr"
      ]
    }
  },
  "explanation": "Ansible action that initializes Docker Swarm mode in lab and retrieves worker and manager join tokens."
}

        "name": "find-uid0-users",

      },
      {
        "id": "5",
        "undo": false,
        "name": "find-old-logins",
        "action_type": "SHELL",

        "target": "all",
        "parent_step_ids": []
      },
      {
        "id": "6",
        "undo": false,
        "name": "generate-audit-report",
        "action_type": "SHELL",
        "code": "echo \"=== User Audit Report ===\" && echo \"UID 0 users: $(wc -l < /tmp/audit_uid0.txt)\" && echo \"Empty passwords: $(wc -l < /tmp/audit_empty_pass.txt)\" && echo \"Sudo users: $(cat /tmp/audit_sudo.txt)\" && echo \"Login shells: $(wc -l < /tmp/audit_shells.txt)\" && echo \"Inactive 90d: $(wc -l < /tmp/audit_old_logins.txt)\"",
        "target": "all",
        "parent_step_ids": [
          "1",
          "2",
          "3",
          "4",
          "5"
        ]
      }
    ]
  },
